title: A View-only replay of the status PATCH shows a 403 Access denied. toast with no redirect
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (c) custom role "QA PL View only". Data: QAPL-T3 (active); take its id from the GET /api/inventory/parts response in the Network tab. Create and change bodies captured earlier as (a) (New Inventory Part save and QAPL-T3 saved unchanged).
custom_steps:
1. As (c) open /parts/inventory.
  2. Replay PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<QAPL-T3 id>"],"status":"inactive"} from DevTools on this page.
  3. Reload the Active tab and search QAPL-T3.
  4. Replay POST /api/inventory/parts/create with the captured body from DevTools.
  5. Go back to /parts/inventory and replay POST /api/inventory/parts/change with QAPL-T3's captured body.
custom_expected:
1. Both tabs show; there is no ⋮ actions menu and no New Inventory Part button.
  2. 403; an error toast "Access denied." shows and the page stays on the Inventory list (no redirect).
  3. QAPL-T3 is still on the Active tab; nothing changed.
  4. 403; the app goes to the access-denied page; no part is created.
  5. 403; the app goes to the access-denied page; QAPL-T3 is unchanged.
